svg.title: One turn, end to end
svg.desc: Nine steps across a session: probe, assemble and plan the boundary, retrieve, call the model, report usage, commit, propose pins, compact at the trigger, and flush. Each is optional, and with no daemon the harness behaves as if Sakur4 were absent.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What happens in one turn

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Everything here is optional. With no daemon reachable, the harness behaves exactly as it did before.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A sidecar that breaks your session when it is down is worse than no sidecar at all.
